test_title: Delhi Police Constable (Executive) 2023 - Reasoning (Held on: 22 Nov, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Which figure should replace the question mark (?) if the following series were to be continued?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/05feb9ee4c061741ae66a8ce4890d135473026b22c684e810cbe856a6bc9b1e4.png]
solution:
The logic followed here is:

From figure 1 to 2 and figure 3 to 4:

Top-left and bottom-right and top-right and bottom-left elements are interchanging their position respectively.

All 4 middle element are shifting their position in anticlockwise direction.

From figure 2 to 3 and figure 4 to 5:

Bottom-left and bottom-right symbols are shifting top-right and top-left position respectively.

Middle-bottom-left and middle-bottom-right symbols are bottom-left and bottom-right position respectively.

Middle-top-left and middle-top-right symbols are middle-bottom-right and middle-bottom-left position respectively.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d6a8b372d3207da43e1b0c769118cf37397d2176e99e3b3c9f55e451a30b3d76.png] 

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 3".
